description: Altis RandomAccess: exactly 4*N LFSR XOR updates to a power-of-two table, using retrying 64-bit CAS or paired 32-bit XOR atomics; full measured-table CPU verification.

scaling_param.name: table_size
scaling_param.description: Number of 64-bit table entries; must be a positive power of two. Logical update count is exactly four times this size.

non_scaling_params.name: atomic_mode
non_scaling_params.description: Pinned atomic implementation: retrying 64-bit CAS or paired 32-bit XOR operations.

non_scaling_params.name: num_threads
non_scaling_params.description: Requested GPU thread count; rounds up to full blocks and partitions the same fixed 4*N logical update stream.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
